integrity: The conservation-law space, fixed-signal equilibria, transient Taylor coefficient, and convergence argument are reconstructed directly from the printed reaction network. Exact arithmetic in the bundled checker is supplemental; the infinite-time convergence claim is proved analytically.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns the explicit two-reaction network in the motivating example and does not classify all detailed-balance adaptation networks.
The convergence proof assumes the motivating work's admissible-signal regularity, exponentially decaying logarithmic rate, and positive limiting signal.
Search and source inspection cannot exclude an unindexed later correction or commentary.
title: Exact repair of a detailed-balance adaptation example: species 2 adapts and species 3 tracks the signal
